typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystTradePlusFourSettlements_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		current_par as string,
		entry_time as date,
		runDate as date,
		total_cash as string,
		runDateTime as timestamp,
		settle_date as string,
		trader as string,
		inventory as string,
		trade_date as string,
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		TradeSettleDateDiffValue as integer,
		principal as string,
		salesperson as string,
		ext_counterparty_id as string,
		price as string,
		counterparty as string,
		legal_entity as string,
		currency as string,
		buy_sell as string,
		import_source as string,
		isin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCatalystTrade
fromtblCatalystTrade sink(input(
		current_par as string,
		entry_time as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		runDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		total_cash as string,
		runDateTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		settle_date as string,
		trader as string,
		inventory as string,
		trade_date as string,
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		TradeSettleDateDiffValue as integer,
		principal as string,
		salesperson as string,
		ext_counterparty_id as string,
		price as string,
		counterparty as string,
		legal_entity as string,
		currency as string,
		buy_sell as string,
		import_source as string,
		isin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		current_par,
		entry_time,
		runDate,
		total_cash,
		runDateTime,
		settle_date,
		trader,
		inventory,
		trade_date,
		catalyst_trade_number,
		TradeSettleDateDiffValue,
		principal,
		salesperson,
		ext_counterparty_id,
		price,
		counterparty,
		legal_entity,
		currency,
		buy_sell,
		import_source,
		isin),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystTradePlusFourSettlements_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystTradePlusFourSettlements
